current_reproduction.setup: Start from an isolated checkout at the published revision containing this validation record. Install Git, uv and the pinned Lean toolchain. Create validation-output; use new filenames and preserve old captures.
current_reproduction.inventory_extraction_python:
import json
from pathlib import Path
record = json.loads(Path("docs/design/parallel-qrom-review-response-validation.json").read_text())
assert record["source_commit"], "Use the finalized record with its actual source commit"
out = Path("validation-output")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for label, count in [("historical_64", 64), ("current_65", 65)]:
    modules = record["contract_modules"][label]
    assert len(modules) == count
    (out / (label + ".txt")).write_text("\n".join(modules) + "\n")
(out / "source-commit.txt").write_text(record["source_commit"] + "\n")
current_reproduction.build_and_capture_shell:
QROM_OUTPUT_DIR="$(pwd)/validation-output"
QROM_SOURCE_REV="$(cat validation-output/source-commit.txt)"
git worktree add --detach ../qrom-reviewed-source "$QROM_SOURCE_REV"
git worktree add --detach ../qrom-review-baseline 67ca1cdff44a38757999d34152412e78a52c1d5e
QROM_SOURCE_DIR="$(cd ../qrom-reviewed-source && pwd)"
QROM_BASELINE_DIR="$(cd ../qrom-review-baseline && pwd)"
(cd "$QROM_BASELINE_DIR" && lake exe cache get && lake build VCVio)
(cd "$QROM_SOURCE_DIR" && lake exe cache get && lake build VCVio)
uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python "$QROM_SOURCE_DIR/scripts/check-quantum-port-contracts.py" capture \
  "$QROM_BASELINE_DIR" "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/reproduced-baseline-64.json" \
  --root VCVio --modules-file "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/historical_64.txt"
uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python "$QROM_SOURCE_DIR/scripts/check-quantum-port-contracts.py" capture \
  "$QROM_SOURCE_DIR" "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/reproduced-current-64.json" \
  --root VCVio --modules-file "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/historical_64.txt"
uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python "$QROM_SOURCE_DIR/scripts/check-quantum-port-contracts.py" capture \
  "$QROM_SOURCE_DIR" "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/reproduced-current-65.json" \
  --root VCVio --modules-file "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/current_65.txt"
uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python "$QROM_SOURCE_DIR/scripts/check-quantum-port-contracts.py" compare \
  "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/reproduced-baseline-64.json" "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/reproduced-current-64.json" \
  --modules "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/historical_64.txt" --out "$QROM_OUTPUT_DIR/reproduced-comparison.json"
